basic_details.job_title: TNPESU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The Demand Draft shall be drawn in favour of "The Registrar, Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University", payable at Chennai at any Nationalized Bank.

age_limit.details: As per applicable CMRG / Government / University norms.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project assistant: PG degree in Sports Biomechanics / Sports Science / Exercise Physiology / Physical Education / Physiotherapy OR UG degree in Footwear Design / Footwear Technology / Biomedical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Material Science / A relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institution are eligible. (A minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree is desirable).

selection_process: Shortlisting based on qualification and relevant experience
followed by a Written Test/Interview as prescribed by the University/Project.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official website www.tnpesu.org.
Fill in all required details in the application form accurately.
Enclose self-attested copies of Degree/Diploma and Experience Certificates.
Attach proof of community and other necessary certificates where applicable.
Enclose the Demand Draft for the application fee drawn in favour of The Registrar, Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University.
Send the filled-in application by post to "The Registrar, Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University, Melakottaiyur (Po), Chennai - 600 127".
Ensure the application reaches the university on or before 15.10.2026 before 5.00 p.m.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the CMRG project. Duration of the project is 3 years. The selected candidate shall work full-time for the project. The appointment shall not confer any right to claim regular appointment or absorption in the University. Continuation of the appointment is subject to satisfactory performance and progress of the project. The candidate shall not simultaneously draw any other fellowship/financial assistance from another funding agency. No separate call letter will be sent to the candidates for the interview. Eligible candidates are requested to attend the interview on 16.10.2026 at 11.00 a.m. in the TNPESU Campus.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University (TNPESU) is conducting the recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited through this notification?
faq.answer: The post is Project Assistant under the CMRG project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the filled-in application is 15 October 2026 before 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PG degree in Sports Biomechanics / Sports Science / Exercise Physiology / Physical Education / Physiotherapy OR a UG degree in Footwear Design / Footwear Technology / Biomedical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Material Science / A relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 250/- for SC/ST and Differently Abled persons, and Rs. 500/- for other communities.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the website, fill it out, attach required certificates and Demand Draft, and send it by post to the Registrar, TNPESU.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting according to qualifications and relevant experience, followed by a Written Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted on 16 October 2026 at 11.00 a.m. at the TNPESU Campus.
